Name: All Cuter Fatter Animals
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
Bring back the cuteness and chonkiness to your coops and barns! With permission from the amazing [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Identitypollution]IdentityPollution[/url], here's an unofficial update to his [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3640]cuter fatter animals series[/url]. It includes everything from the original mods and adds sprites for all missing animals and babies, icons for Marnie's shop, a completely redone code with way too many config options, and more!
[line]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]White, Brown[/b] and [b]Blue Chickens:[/b] Can be individually configured to have a wattle or not, so you can have as much variety as you want!
[*][b]Void[/b] and[b] Golden Chickens:[/b] Void chickens are ~space themed~ and I love them, while Golden chickens have a wattle option just like their blue cousins!
[*][b]Ducks:[/b] Based on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3612]Bill Cipher mod[/url]﻿ and with two options to choose from, literally the Bill sprites or an edited version to look more vanilla / duck-like!
[*][b]Goat:[/b] Now with two options to choose from, the original cuter fatter goat or one with a less wide front view (100% personal preference)!
[*][b]Ostriches:[/b] The big chonkin that took me way too long to make, finally here...!
[*][b]Rabbits[/b], [b]Dinos[/b], [b]White[/b] and [b]Brown Cows[/b], [b]Sheep[/b] and [b]Pigs:[/b] The original cuties are already perfect, what more can I say?
[*][b]Babies![/b] Now all animals have matching baby sprites, so they can truly be cute babies that both match [i]and [/i]are distinct from adults!
[*][b]Objects:[/b] Replaces Void Eggs and Void Mayo to fit the new space Void Chickens, as well as Mayo, Duck Mayo, Milk and Large Milk to be much cuter!
[*][b]Marnie's shop icons:[/b] Replaces enabled animals' icons in Marnie's shop to match! Fully matches the config options too.
[*][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] Animals enabled here will also replace [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿'s animals, so they can be cuter and fatter too!
[/list][line]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b][i]Config[/i][/b][/size][/color]
As you've probably already seen, there are a lot of config options [size=1](I love configs too much what can I say)[/size], so everything can be tweaked to your heart's content! As always, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to easily edit these. And if you haven't already, check the [i]Images[/i] tab to see all options!
The options are pretty self explanatory and I already explained the available variants in [i]Features[/i] (+ they're described in the in-game config menu), but if anyone wants a more detailed look:
[spoiler]
[color=#d9d2e9][b][i]Coop Animals[/i][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]White Chicken:[/b] Choose whether White Chickens have a wattle ("Wattle") or not ("NoWattle"), or disable them with "Off"
[*][b]Brown Chicken:[/b] Choose whether Brown Chickens have a wattle ("Wattle") or not ("NoWattle"), or disable them with "Off"
[*][b]Blue Chicken:[/b] Choose whether Blue Chickens have a wattle ("Wattle") or not ("NoWattle"), or disable them with "Off"
[*][b]Void Chicken:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[*][b]Golden Chicken:[/b] Choose whether Golden Chickens have a wattle ("Wattle") or not ("NoWattle"), or disable them with "Off"
[*][b]Duck:[/b] Choose whether Ducks are literally Bill Cipher ("Bill"), an alternative version that edits them to look more like normal ducks ("Alt"), or disable them with "Off"
[*][b]Rabbit:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[*][b]Dino:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[/list]
[color=#d9d2e9][b][i]Barn Animals[/i][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]White Cow:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[*][b]Brown Cow:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[*][b]Sheep:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[*][b]Goat:[/b] Choose whether Goats have their original sprites ("Chonky") a version that has a slightly less wide face when they're facing front ("Alt"), or disable them with "Off"
[*][b]Pig:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[*][b]Ostrich:[/b] Enable / Disable them
[/list]
[color=#d9d2e9][b][i]Objects[/i][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Void Objects:[/b] Enable / Disable the Void Egg and Void Mayo replacements that match this mod's Void Chickens
[*][b]Mayo:[/b] Enable / Disable the Mayo replacement
[*][b]Duck Mayo:[/b] Enable / Disable the Duck Mayo replacement
[*][b]Milk:[/b] Enable / Disable the Milk and Large Milk replacements
[/list][/spoiler][line]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b][i]Compatibility[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]It's [color=#93c47d]compatible[/color] with pretty much any mod![/b] As in, it won't cause any bugs - other visual mods which change enabled animals or objects here may override these or vice versa [size=1](but that's what configs are for so...)[/size].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿:[/b] As mentioned in [i]Features[/i], it's [color=#93c47d][b]compatible[/b][/color] and its animals will be cuter and fatter too!
[*]﻿[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]:[/b] Yes, it's [color=#93c47d][b]compatible[/b][/color]. No, [b][color=#ffe599]it doesn't change SVE's new animals[/color][/b] - and no, I won't make them, simply because I don't play with it and they would take too much time. If anyone else wants to do it they're welcome to contact me to add them here, or publish them independently!
[/list][line]

[b][i][color=#b4a7d6][size=3]Credits[/size][/color][/i][/b]
Of course, all credits go to the amazing [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Identitypollution]IdentityPollution[/url]! He made the original mods - all the animal sprites and items are his art and fully belong to him! Even the sprites I "made" are just derived or heavily based on his art, so they're still his to credit!

I don't know if you'll ever read this, Identity Pollution, but thank you so much for all of these adorable animals, and giving permission to make this unofficial update! Even if you've moved on from Stardew Valley, your contributions are still greatly beloved!
